confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several travel and cost-of-living aggregators that disagree by 2-3x, so treat them as rough. Beer, cocktail and wine are weak: I found no direct Chennai cocktail or wine price, so cocktail is set at about 2x beer and wine at about 1.9x beer. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no live listings checked. The FX rate is the RBA Exchange Rates Overview figure for 15 Oct 2026 as reported in search results; I did not open the F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other Indian metros, using the INR figures from aggregators converted at roughly 95 INR per USD. Hotel and hostel tiers are based on general knowledge of Chennai accommodation levels for July 2026, not on inspected listings.
